output_list.criticism: The 'uploadBalances' function does not require any value, allowing a large uint256 input from a malicious user or external contract, aka overflow Integer, aka exploitable in life and beneficial to attackers.

The 'transfer' function has a similar vulnerability, allowing a large uint256 input from a malicious user or external contract, aka overflow Integer, aka exploitable in life and beneficial to attackers.
The 'transferFrom' function has a large uint256 input from a malicious user or external contract, aka overflow Integer, aka exploitable in life and beneficial to attackers.
The 'setExportFee' function allows a malicious owner to set the fee of any user, aka exploitable in real world and beneficial to attackers.
The 'precalculate' function is not time-sensitive, aka predictable randomness, aka vulnerable to attackers' attacks in real world.
